Muhlenberg College · Beyond the classroom

Muhlenberg College Experiences

The work, people, friendships, travel, and everyday outings that filled out my college experience beyond a course list.

Internship Events People Japan Allentown

English & Creative Writing Social Media Internship

I worked on social media for Muhlenberg’s English & Creative Writing Department, helping create posts and share writing-related content. It connected my interest in writing with public-facing communications.

The internship was part of how I explored applying creative and communication skills in a working context.

Organizing Events & Student Communities

Through my clubs and MAC, I planned and supported on-campus events and activities. There was the visible part of an event, and the organizing behind it: communicating, arranging meetings, coordinating people, and working with other board members.

Explore Clubs & Leadership

Friendships & Professors

Bringing Friends Together

Within my broader friend group, I was often the organizer: inviting people over, making plans, communicating, and helping everyone connect.

Getting to Know Professors

I built rapport with various professors during my time at Muhlenberg. Those relationships were part of the experience of studying across different fields.

Learning in Japan

My Japan MILA experience was one of the memorable ways my coursework extended beyond campus. It combined studies in ecology and religion with a two-week trip.

Read About the Japan MILA

Exploring Allentown

Some of my favorite parts of college were local: spending time in the parks, walking around residential Allentown, and going to the Farmers Market. The surrounding area became part of my everyday college life.
